## Summary

| Metric | Champion v5 | Last PASS Candidate |
|--------|-------------|---------------------|
| Tuning Mean | **1.904** | 1.762 |
| Tuning Min | **0.431** | 0.051 |
| Lockbox Mean | 1.793 | **1.793** |
| Lockbox Min | 1.134 | **1.347** |
| Worst MDD | **-9.31%** | -11.18% |

## Assessment

**Champion holds.** The candidate shows improved lockbox robustness (min 1.35 vs 1.13) but the critically weak tuning min (0.05) and deeper worst MDD (-11.2%) indicate overfitting risk. Good decision to PASS without promoting.

## Status
- ✅ Runloop healthy (159 iterations, ~31h remaining)
- ✅ No INCONCLUSIVE backlog
- ✅ Next commands queued

Standing by for next handoff or escalation.
